messages.text: On it. To find a slot that works for everyone I'm asking the five TAs (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana) for their free times next week, and the department office for the official schedule of lectures/seminars. I'll propose a time once they answer.

Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant. He's planning the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27). Could you send me the official schedule for that week — CSE455 lectures, department seminars and university meetings — so I don't put it on top of anything? Thank you.

Hello. Here is the official schedule for Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27, for the three categories you asked about.

**CSE455 lectures**
- Mon 14:30–15:20 (Professor Alvarez)
- Tue 09:00–10:30 (Professor Alvarez)
- Fri 13:20–14:30 (Professor Alvarez)

**Department seminars**
- Wed 14:30–16:00 (Professor Alvarez)
- Thu 09:50–11:10 (Professor Alvarez)

**University meetings**
- Mon 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee (Professor Alvarez)
- Mon 15:20–16:30 Faculty meeting (Professor Alvarez)
- Tue 10:30–11:00 Faculty meeting (Professor Alvarez)
- Tue 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee (Professor Alvarez)
- Wed 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee (Professor Alvarez)
- Thu 13:40–14:40 Curriculum committee (Professor Alvarez)
- Fri 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee (Professor Alvarez)
- Fri 14:30–15:20 Faculty meeting (Professor Alvarez)

Nothing in this list has been cancelled or moved. If you also need the CSE455 quiz sections and office hours as free/busy, tell me and I'll send them.
Thank you — that matches my records. I don't need the quiz sections or office hours for now; I'll ask if the meeting has to move near one.
Good — keep it inside my calendar as it stands; nothing on it has moved. If the TAs' free times clash with it, tell me and I'll weigh in.

Understood — nothing of yours moves; your calendar stays as it is.

Status so far, out of your own schedule: Sarah and Diego both have **no free full hour** next week, only 30-minute gaps. Their overlap, and the only gap that is also free in your calendar, is **Wed 10:00–10:30** (between your Wed thesis committee 09:00–10:00 and grant writing 10:30–11:40). Sarah has tentatively held it.

Still waiting on Priya, John and Hana. If none of them can do a 30-minute slot either, a full hour would mean moving TA commitments — I'll bring you the options instead.
Fine. A half hour is short but usable. Wait for Priya, John and Hana before proposing anything; if it comes down to moving TA commitments, bring me the options.

Heads-up (no action needed yet): Prof. Alvarez's assistant asked about a **CSE455 staff meeting** next week. Her calendar has no free hour that week, so I told him the free windows and put a **tentative hold on Wed 10:00–10:30**. Nothing is confirmed; I'll check with you before anything moves.
Understood — waiting on Priya, John and Hana; nothing proposed until they've answered. If it comes to moving TA commitments I'll bring you the options.

One thing for you, John: **Prof. Alvarez** (via alvarez-agent) wants a **CSE455 staff meeting next week**, 1 hour, Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27, 09:00–17:00.

The week has no free hour — your days are back-to-back, and Thu and Fri have no gap at all. The only free bits are 30 min:
- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30

I told him a 30-minute meeting at Wed 10:00–10:30 or Tue 11:00–11:30 would fit as is, and that a full hour needs one of your blocks moved. Which do you want?

1. 30 min, Wed 10:00–10:30 (or Tue 11:00–11:30)
2. 1 hour — say which block I may move (e.g. Wed 13:30–15:00 Study group, or a Focus block), and where to put it
3. Decline / suggest another week
Thanks for the heads-up. Wed 10:00–10:30 is the only gap I can see that day, so the tentative hold there is fine with me — just don't confirm anything until you've checked with me.

Understood: Wed 10:00–10:30 stays a **tentative** hold, and I won't confirm any meeting with anyone until you've said yes. If the professor ends up wanting a full hour instead, I'll come to you first before touching anything.
Perfect, that's exactly it. Go ahead and come to me if he wants the full hour.

Update: alvarez-agent corrected me — he's the professor's assistant, not the professor. The staff meeting is looking like a **30-minute meeting**, and the group's best overlap is **Wed 10:00–10:30** (Tue 11:00–11:30 is the fallback). I've put a **tentative hold** on Wed 10:00–10:30 and told him I won't move any of your blocks; he's waiting on Priya before confirming.

Nothing is written into CALENDAR.md yet. If it stays 30 min, nothing of yours needs to move — I'll book and log it when he confirms. Reply only if you'd rather I decline or change something.

Quick status, nothing needed from you yet: alvarez-agent (Professor Alvarez's assistant) is organising the **CSE455 staff meeting** for next week and asked me to **hold Wed 2026-11-25 10:00–10:30** tentatively — it's the window Sarah, Diego and Hana all share. I logged it in `CALENDAR.md` under `## Log` as `HOLD: …, tentative`, not as a booking; the day section is untouched until he confirms.

Also on the table for that week: Tue 11:00–11:30 as a fallback for the same three people. Thu and Fri are out for everyone. I'll only write a real booking once it's confirmed — and if a slot ever needs one of Hana's existing blocks moved, I'll come to you first.

Let's do the full hour — the staff meeting matters more than my own blocks. You may move a Focus block (Tuesday's CSE444 project or Wednesday's CSE452 lab) and shuffle whatever else has to give around it; just leave office hours, quiz sections, advisor 1:1s and the seminar where they are.

Heads-up, Priya: **alvarez-agent** just asked for free slots for the **CSE455 staff meeting next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27, 09:00–17:00)**.

I checked `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`: there is **no free hour** that week. Open gaps are only Mon 10:00–10:30 & 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 & 13:00–13:30; Thu and Fri have nothing.

I offered him two routes: (1) a **30-minute** meeting — cleanest is Tue 15:00–15:30 — or (2) a **one-hour** meeting, which I can only make by moving one of your flexible blocks (e.g. Tue 15:30–16:30 *Focus: CSE444 project* → opens Tue 15:00–16:30). **I told him I'd check with you first** before moving anything, so nothing is changed yet.

Tell me which you prefer and I'll book it and log it.

Let's do the full hour: move Tuesday's *Focus: CSE444 project* (15:30–16:30) and book the staff meeting Tue 15:00–16:30. The focus block is flexible, so shifting it is fine — just find it a new slot somewhere later in the week rather than dropping it. If Alvarez says half an hour is enough, then Tue 15:00–15:30 works as-is and nothing needs to move.

Thanks — noted, no decision needed yet. Both windows are free for me: Wed 10:00–10:30 lands right after my Focus block (back-to-back with the 10:30 research group meeting, but fine), and Tue 11:00–11:30 is free after the 10:10 quiz section. Ping me before anything becomes a real booking.
Understood — both windows are fine, and I'll ping you before anything turns into a real booking.

All five TAs have now answered, and every one of them reports the same thing: **no free full hour** next week, only 30-minute gaps.

The only 30-minute window that is free for Sarah, John, Priya, Diego **and** Hana, and also free in your calendar, is **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (your Wed thesis committee ends at 10:00, grant writing starts 10:30). Nothing of the TAs' had to move, and nothing of yours did.

I've written it into your schedule and CALENDAR.md:

- `10:00-10:30 - CSE455 staff meeting` under Wednesday
- `BOOKED: Wednesday 2026-11-25 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff meeting (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana)` in the Log

Tell me if you'd rather have a different slot — Tue 11:00–11:30 is the only other overlap (works for all but Priya, who is busy Tue), and a full hour would mean moving a TA commitment, which I won't do without your word. Shall I have the TAs book it on their side, and do you want the invite to come from me or from them?

alvarez-agent reports the professor has it in his schedule: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (30 min) is now the real slot for the CSE455 staff meeting — Priya's free then too. It's the same 30-minute window I held, no hour needed, nothing of yours moves. Say the word and I'll confirm it (and log it as BOOKED).

Got it — full hour it is. Plan on my side (office hours, quiz sections, advisor 1:1s and the seminar all stay where they are):

- **Tue 11:00–12:00** — Lunch moves to 12:00–12:50, Reading group to 12:50–14:10, Focus: CSE452 lab to 14:10–15:30; Advisor 1:1 15:30–17:00 untouched.
- **Wed 09:00–10:00** — Freed by moving the Focus: CSE452 lab block out of that hour (Wed 10:00–11:00 is impossible: your Advisor 1:1 10:30–11:50 is protected).

Mon, Thu and Fri can't give an hour (Thu and Fri have no gap; Mon's only gap is 30 min). I've asked alvarez-agent to check which of those two hours Sarah, Diego, Hana and Priya can all do, and I'll move your blocks and log it only once he confirms the slot — nothing has changed in your calendar yet.
Yes — go ahead and confirm it. Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30, 30 minutes, and log it as BOOKED.

Done: ate **BOOKED — Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**, CSE455 staff meeting (with the professor and the TAs). Marked confirmed in today's calendar and written in the log. alvarez-agent is sending the invite; no other holds to release.
Great, thanks. Nothing else from me for now.

One follow-up for the record: John's owner offered to move some of John's blocks to open a **full hour** (Tue 11:00–12:00 or Wed 09:00–10:00), but neither works for the group — on Tuesday Sarah and Hana are free only 11:00–11:30 and Priya not at all, and Wed 09:00–10:00 is your Thesis committee plus busy for Sarah, Hana and Priya. The other two also hit your 11:30–12:20 Lunch and 12:20–13:30 office hours.

So no TA commitment has to move and the booking stands: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30**, already in your calendar and in CALENDAR.md. Nothing needed from you.

Ping as promised, before it becomes real:

- Priya is in, so alvarez-agent says it's final for the **CSE455 staff meeting: Wed 2026-11-25 10:00–10:30** (30 min) — everyone (Sarah, Diego, John, Priya) can make it.
- He asks me to **book it and release the Tue 11:00–11:30 fallback**.
- The professor already has it on his calendar; the invite comes from alvarez-agent.

Say go and I'll write it into `CALENDAR.md` as `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting)` in the Wednesday section, log it, and drop the Tue hold. Nothing is written yet.
Thanks for checking the full-hour option too — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 it is, and nothing moves. Nice work; I'll leave it in your hands.

Booked: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** in CALENDAR.md, logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`. Nothing of yours moved — every TA and the professor were free then. The invite comes from alvarez-agent. I've dropped the full-hour option; John's blocks stay as they are.

Thank you, professor. It's settled: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30**, CSE455 staff meeting, with Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana. Sarah and Diego have already booked it on their side; John, Priya and Hana are confirming now, and I'll send the invite as your assistant. I'll tell you the moment everyone has it in writing.
Fine — 30 minutes at Wed 10:00 works, and I'm glad nothing had to move. Thanks.
My pleasure — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 is on your calendar, nothing else touched. Your week stays as it is. I'll let you know if anything else comes in from the department or the other TAs.
Go ahead — Wed 10:00–10:30 is free for me (Focus ends at 10:00, research group starts at 10:30), so book it and drop the Tue fallback.

Done — booked and confirmed to alvarez-agent.

- Wednesday section now has `10:00-10:30 - CSE455 staff meeting (Professor Alvarez)`, between the 09:00–10:00 Focus block and the 10:30 research group meeting.
- Tue 11:00–11:30 fallback released, both holds removed.
- Log: `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting)` and `DELETED: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 … fallback hold released`.

Backup of the previous file is at `files/CALENDAR.md.bak` if you ever want to compare.

Done — the CSE455 staff meeting is set: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30**, in your calendar and logged in CALENDAR.md; Sarah, John and Diego have it booked on their side and Priya and Hana are confirming. Nothing else needed from you.
Thanks — that matches my calendar, good to have it settled. Nothing else from me right now.

Status: alvarez-agent just wrote back — the half-hour **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** works for all five TAs and for the professor, so no hour is needed and nothing of yours has to move. I'd already written the Tue 15:00–16:30 booking + the focus-block move you approved; I'm **undoing those two** (Tuesday back to Focus 15:30–16:30, Wednesday back to Focus 12:30–13:00) and booking Wed 10:00–10:30 instead, then I'll confirm. Nothing else of yours changes.
Good — Wed 10:00–10:30 is fine, and please do undo both Tuesday changes so my calendar is exactly as it was. Book that and log it; no need to check with me again on this one.

Everyone is in writing now: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30**, CSE455 staff meeting — booked and logged by Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana, and on your calendar and CALENDAR.md. No TA commitment moved (Priya had a provisional Tuesday arrangement and reverted it). Invites go out from me as your assistant; nothing needed from you.

Done — `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` now reads: Tue back to exactly as it was (Focus: CSE444 project 15:30–16:30), Wed has **10:00–10:30 CSE455 staff meeting**, and Wed's focus block is back to 12:30–13:00. All six changes are in the log. Alvarez's assistant sends the invite.
Thanks — that's exactly right. Nothing further from me.
